Stat Priorities

Stat Ranking

  1. Agility
  2. Haste
  3. Crit
  4. Versatility
  5. Mastery

Stat Outline

Unlike other specs, there is very little way stats augment how we play.

Crit, Mastery, and Vers are all just “more damage”.

Haste is the important one, as we need certain levels of Haste due to Adrenaline Rushes GCD reduction being linked to Haste value. You will need around 25% Haste, but make sure to sim your character to see the exact amount your character specifically needs.
